Description

Luminary AI Photo Editor is the world's most advanced AI-powered photo editing app, bringing professional-grade tools directly to your iPhone and iPad. Whether you're a hobbyist or a seasoned photographer, Luminary's intelligent suite of tools makes every photo extraordinary — no desktop software required.

✦ AI SKY REPLACEMENT

Swap out any sky in seconds. Choose from 80+ dramatic, sunlit, or stormy sky options and watch our AI seamlessly blend it into your scene — adjusting for ground reflections, lighting, and color temperature automatically.

✦ AI PORTRAIT RETOUCH

Look your best every time. Our facial recognition AI detects and enhances skin texture, eyes, teeth, and hair with one slider. Natural results, every time — never over-processed.

✦ AI RELIGHT

Simulate professional studio lighting with our revolutionary Relighting tool. Place a virtual light source anywhere in your photo and watch it naturally illuminate faces and surfaces.

✦ MAGIC ERASER

Remove any unwanted object, person, or blemish with our intelligent content-aware eraser. Just paint over what you want gone — Luminary AI fills in the background perfectly.

✦ 200+ AI PRESETS

  • Cinematic film simulations
  • Moody landscapes & travel edits
  • Portrait-optimized golden hour looks
  • Black & white fine art styles
  • Vintage & analog grain filters

✦ PRO EDITING TOOLS

  • RAW file support (ProRAW compatible)
  • Advanced masking: AI subject, sky, brush, gradient
  • Curves, HSL, tone mapping, split toning
  • Noise reduction & sharpening powered by AI
  • Geometry & perspective correction
  • Non-destructive editing workflow

Luminary AI Photo Editor offers a free tier with core editing features. Unlock the full suite with Luminary AI Pro — available as a monthly or annual subscription.

Subscription auto-renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage subscriptions in your Apple ID Settings.

What's New
Version 4.3.1 · 2 days ago

We're constantly improving Luminary to give you the best editing experience possible. This update brings:

  • New: AI Expand — Extend your photo beyond its edges using generative fill
  • Improved sky replacement blending for overcast scenes
  • Portrait AI now supports glasses detection & glare removal
  • Significantly faster export on iPhone 15 Pro and iPhone 16 series
  • Fixed a crash when importing HEIC files from iCloud Drive
  • Minor performance improvements and bug fixes
